name: email-smtp-imap
description: Search, read, send, reply to and organise email across your own SMTP and IMAP accounts.

email_accounts_json.title: Email accounts (JSON)
email_accounts_json.description: A JSON object keyed by account name, containing SMTP and IMAP hosts, ports, TLS settings, usernames and app passwords. See the setup example in the plugin README.

default_email_account.title: Default email account
default_email_account.description: An account name from the JSON object. Leave blank to use its first account.
